messages:
Maya: Heads-up — noticed conflicting phrasing in /docs/regions/availability.md about 'supported regions' vs 'data residency'. One page uses 'data residency in EU' and another says 'EU region availability' which could confuse customers. Can we align? Links: https://redwood.inference/docs/regions/availability and https://redwood.inference/docs/guides/data-residency. @Ali @Nina

Ali: Good catch. We should add a short clarifier blurb and update the SDK header example to show the difference (`X-Region` vs `X-Data-Residence`). I'll open a PR and tag reviewers.

Sam: If we add a clarifier, let's also include a short migration note for customers using the legacy `region` query param. I can draft the snippet showing curl + Python examples.

Nina: Quick runtime check — we return a 409 when residency and region conflict, but docs don't mention fallback behavior. I'll confirm the exact precedence with eng-runtime.

Maya: Proposed copy for the clarifier (draft): "Region availability indicates where the model can run; data residency indicates where request data is stored. A model available in region A may still store data in region B if residency is configured." Thoughts?

Ali: Love the draft. Make a one-line elevator version for the top of the page: "Availability = where compute runs. Residency = where data is stored." Put the longer note as a footnote/link.

Sam: I'll prepare the SDK snippet. Plan: show curl + Python snippet demonstrating both headers. Use `X-Region: eu-west-1` and `X-Data-Residence: eu` in examples. Also include a short migration note: "If you previously used `?region=...`, set the `X-Region` header instead; `X-Data-Residence` is new for residency control."

Nina: Confirmed with runtime: precedence is `X-Data-Residence` -> `X-Region` header -> account default. When a mismatch happens we return 409 + message: "residency_conflict". Add that exact error string to the troubleshooting section.

Maya: Legal reviewed the short sentence and suggested adding: "We do not move customer data outside selected residency without contractual agreement." Add to residency FAQ.

Ali: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 with the clarifier, updated SDK snippets, and a migration footnote. @Sam can you review the code samples? @Maya please sanity-check the links.

CI-bot: docs build succeeded — no link errors detected.

Sam: Quick nit: in the Python snippet use `headers={'X-Data-Residence': 'eu'}` (dict style) and include `timeout=30` in the request example. I'll push that small commit to PR 4123.

Maya: Thanks all — merged the PR. Small follow-up: can we add an inline example for the Console UI where customers toggle residency? Maybe a screenshot request in a follow-up PR. @Ali can you own that? :+1:

Ali: Yep — will file a follow-up to add a Console screenshot and a short how-to.

Maya: Awesome, closing this thread. :tada:
